chunks: So God seized him for the punishment of the Hereafter and this world.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God seized him with the punishment of the Hereafter and this world?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the comprehensive nature of divine retribution, where the 'nakal' (punitive example) serves not only as immediate chastisement but also as a lasting lesson for the community. The dual reference to the first and last worlds underscores the continuity of punishment, linking the historical defeat of Pharaoh with the eternal consequences for the disbelievers.
